scripts.sync:dev: CAP_DEV=1 pnpm --filter @dl/web build:app-dev && CAP_DEV=1 cap sync android
scripts.apk: pnpm run sync && JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" android/gradlew -p android assembleDebug
scripts.aab: pnpm run sync && JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" android/gradlew -p android bundleRelease
scripts.apk:dev: pnpm run sync:dev && JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" android/gradlew -p android assembleDebug
scripts.dev: pnpm run apk:dev && pnpm run install:emulator
